text: Your Instagram Reel worked. Manychat sent the link. The lead replied... <long pause> and then? <short pause> Nothing. <sigh>
style: telling a friend a slightly painful story, warm and wry, close to the mic, unhurried

text: Then it replies the moment they finish typing. In your voice. Even at two a.m. <short pause> You? <short pause> You're asleep.
style: confident and playful, a knowing smile, light comic timing on the last two words

text: Lead gone quiet? It follows up. Even with a voice note, in your voice. <chuckle> Yes, really.
style: amused and warm, genuinely a little impressed, relaxed
